Sports Arena projects the daily run loop from entry, rank, reward, share, and reset milestones.

Powered By Receiz exposes Sports as a live conformance badge with the rest of the public trust badges.
Sports card backs print offline proof identity, issue, claim, basis, media, source, and rarity odds where applicable.
Public card stage stays a 3D proof object that flips by click, keyboard, or swipe without replacing card truth.

Owned card event panels expose tiny copy/share/watch actions for direct event proof links.
Sports Event Proof market routes settle purchases and proof-for-proof offers through existing Sports market mechanics.
Owner vault public projections advance a compact manifest-only proof head with verified membership, Merkle root, predecessor continuity, immutable history, CAS, and effective public username.
Vault showcase admission verifies manifest identity, archive hash, Merkle root, card count, sport, and optional client claims.
Online card transfers append ownership provenance, update both public vault projections, and block trade-locked cards.

Sports trades are scoped by sport and preserve proof-native offer items and value holds.
Trade accept/decline/cancel actions update ownership projections and write action ledger events.
Soccer and UFC packs reuse shared Sports pack purchase mechanics with sport-scoped configs instead of forking baseball truth.
Soccer and UFC entries reuse shared Sports entry mechanics with sport-scoped verified card claims.

Sports card market value remains deterministic from card state, current pack/card odds, issue rank, live score, append memory, performance, canonical PHI conversion, and the same live pulse quote motion used by market assets.
Event proof market panel includes live value, pulse value, PHI value, deterministic chart rows, and additive live pulse motion.
Sports conformance publishes the deterministic live market value algorithm and every input needed to reconstruct any card or event price at any pulse.

evidence.acquisitionFormula: acquisitionBasis.usdValue = roundCents((expectedPacks x currentPackPriceUsd) x qualityMultiplier x realizedMultiplier)
evidence.floorFormula: deterministicFloorUsdValue = sportsArenaUsdFromValueBasis((rating + projection + live) x tier x issue)
evidence.valueBasisDisplay: single-card value panels render current pack basis, exact card odds, quality, player, issue, career, live score, realized premium, performance, floor, and result from sportsArenaCardValueProjection.acquisitionBasis

liveMarketValueAlgorithm.name: Sports live market value projection
liveMarketValueAlgorithm.baseTruth: cards use sportsArenaCardValueProjection: max(deterministic card floor, current pack acquisition basis) x performance; events use proofValueBasis through sportsArenaUsdFromValueBasis
liveMarketValueAlgorithm.formula: currentUsdValue = roundCents(max(deterministicFloorUsdValue, acquisitionBasis.usdValue) x performanceMultiplier); liveUsdValue = roundCents(baseUsdValue + liveLiftUsd); chartLine = append(lineValues, liveUsdValue)
formulaTrace: current odds: expectedPacks = current pack-catalog rarity probability; cardExpectedPacks = current rarity probability x current player-selection probability
premiumMultiplier = playerMultiplier x issueMultiplier x careerMultiplier x scoreMultiplier
acquisitionBasis.usdValue = roundCents(packCostBasisUsd x qualityMultiplier x realizedMultiplier)
deterministicFloorUsdValue = sportsArenaUsdFromValueBasis((rating + projection + live) x tier x issue)
liveMarketValueAlgorithm.floorRule: liveUsdValue never prices below baseUsdValue; negative/risk events use a low collectible reserve amplifier instead of a negative market price.
liveMarketValueAlgorithm.oddsRule: acquisitionBasis displays current pack-catalog rarity odds and exact card odds before sealed issuance odds.
liveMarketValueAlgorithm.valueBasisDisplay: single-card value panels render current pack basis, exact card odds, quality, player, issue, career, live score, realized premium, performance, floor, and result from sportsArenaCardValueProjection.acquisitionBasis

offlineReplayManifest.replayPath: card replay package -> live score -> current rate -> value projection
manualReplaySteps: Verify the card claim schema, collectible id, claim hash, baseCard.sealedCardId, proof.basisHash, issue proof, and pack/economy fields.
Resolve the current registry card by exact sealed card id first, then card id, then media.sourceId. If no registry card is present, use the sealed claim card.

For live score, prefer liveAppends. Pick the newest append by observedAt, createdAt, then sourceDate; group rows by its gamePk when present, otherwise by sourceDate; sum scoreDelta and round to one decimal.

If no liveAppends exist, repeat the same grouping with eventProofs. If neither source exists and a verified currentRegistryCard is present, liveScore is currentRegistryCard.currentScore. Otherwise liveScore is 0.
Compute baseRate from claim.rating. Compute cardRate from the resolved current registry card, with sparse-stat and impossible-drop guards from sportsArenaOwnedCardCurrentRating.
Compute performanceMultiplier from bestArenaScore, careerEntryCount, and cashFinishCount unless an admitted performanceMultiplier is supplied.
Compute value with sportsArenaCardValueProjection using claim, currentRegistryCard/displayCards, liveScore, and performanceMultiplier.
The public UI may display the result, but the replay package and formulas are the proof boundary for offline reproduction.

rateFormulaSections.title: Batter rate
rows: inputs = PA, OPS, OBP, SLG, HR, SB, R, RBI, TB, rosterStatus, personId
rateScore = clamp((OPS - 0.63) x 34, -8, 18) + clamp((OBP - 0.31) x 42, -5, 10) + clamp((SLG - 0.38) x 18, -4, 8)
countScore = min(17, HR x 0.7 + SB x 0.35 + (R + RBI) x 0.07 + TB x 0.035)

rateFormulaSections.title: Pitcher rate
rows: inputs = IP, K, ERA, WHIP, SV, HLD, W, GS, rosterStatus, personId
runScore = clamp((4.55 - ERA) x 4, -10, 16) + clamp((1.36 - WHIP) x 17, -7, 13)
starterVolumeScore = min(8, IP / 8 + W x 0.35 + GS x 0.22)
leverageScore = min(7, SV x 0.7 + HLD x 0.32)
countScore = min(16, K x 0.11 + IP x 0.08 + starterVolumeScore + leverageScore)

scoreFormulaSections.title: Live score
rows: latest row = newest observedAt, then createdAt, then sourceDate
liveScore = round1(sum(scoreDelta for rows matching latest gamePk; if latest gamePk empty, rows matching latest sourceDate))
currentRegistryCard.currentScore is used only when no append/event rows are present

workedReplayExamples.title: Uploaded image with current registry card
rows: Verify receiz.sports_arena.card_seal_manifest, then verify claimHash and issue proof.
Resolve currentRegistryCard by sealed card id, card id, or media.sourceId from the public current registry seed.
With no append rows, liveScore = currentRegistryCard.currentScore.
Value uses the resolved currentRegistryCard rating and the currentRegistryCard score.

workedReplayExamples.title: Append replay package
rows: Find the newest row by observedAt, createdAt, sourceDate.
Sum scoreDelta for that gamePk or sourceDate, round to one decimal, then project value from that score.
